method: Rendered the accepted PDF pages to PNG with Poppler and inspected the page images at readable scale.
observations: Opening title, Telugu paragraphs, unit headings and print margins are legible.
Formerly stranded unit labels on sampled pages remain inline with their headings.
Mathematical notation, formal proof layouts, source-defect notices and closing attribution are visible.
Pages 103 and 250 have short content followed by white space because the next statement is kept together; they are not empty pages.
scope_limit: Visual inspection is sampled and does not constitute a page-by-page linguistic or mathematical expert review; all-page text-layer, pagination, font, tag and unit-coverage checks are recorded separately.
